justification: The cistern board's two halves are joined by exactly one floor cell, (3,5): column 5 is wall at every other row. Every path from the start (3,1) to the goal (3,9) therefore occupies (3,5) at the end of some command -- there is no teleport and no slide on this board, so a cell cannot be crossed without being stood on. Declaring a loss there makes every such path terminate before it arrives.
notes: Value 6 is the cart's colour in A2's palette, so the predicate reads 'the cart is standing on this cell' in the frame the arm acts on.
